description: Check a shopping cart against the customer's instruction before the payment is captured. Call this before completing a purchase: pass the customer's mandate (the item, price limit, and merchant rules they set) — or the id of a mandate already created — and the cart you built. ProveCart returns a signed verdict: MATCH (the cart matches; proceed), REVIEW (genuinely in-between; the response names exactly what to fix - correct it and resubmit), or BLOCK (a clear mismatch; do not pay). Every check leaves a sealed evidence record; ProveCart never holds or moves money. Non-MATCH responses follow the Agent Correction Format (ACF): a machine-readable corrections array (dimension, action, expected, actual, reason), a retry budget, and a sealed evidence pointer (spec: https://provecart.com/standards/correction-format). Requires an integrator API key in the X-API-Key header.

cart.description: The cart the agent built: merchant, items, total_price, currency, tax, shipping, fees (the shape of POST /verify, without mandate_id).
cart.title: VerifyIn

mandate.description: The customer's instruction as a mandate object (the shape of the REST mandate endpoint for this kind). Provide either 'mandate' or 'mandate_id'.
mandate.title: MandateIn

mandate_id.description: The id of a mandate already created through the REST API. Provide either 'mandate' or 'mandate_id'.
